title.note: Name of the RO; a planned RO gets a short name in [square brackets]. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

Description.note: What the RO is. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

identifier.note: Persistent link to the RO as an https URL: https://doi.org/… where it has a DOI (for Zenodo the DOI for all versions), otherwise its landing page. Empty while the RO is planned; never a storage path. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

privateLink.note: Where non-public files are kept, such as a project-drive path. Never an access key or other secret: anyone with the link can read this sheet.

caseStudy.note: Case studies the RO serves; Other if none of the three. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

regulatoryQuestion.note: Regulatory questions of the case studies the RO addresses (platform.vhp4safety.nl/casestudies/<case>/Q1 or Q2); N/A if none. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

workPackage.note: VHP4Safety work package that produced the RO.

workflowStep.note: Process flow steps of the VHP4Safety glossary (glossary.vhp4safety.nl). On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

status.note: Public: the files are openly available. Shared: not public, and the files are in the deposit folder on the tracker owner's laptop. Partially shared: some of them are. Not shared: the owner does not have them. Private: in a public repository but not yet released. On BioStudies rows the daily script sets Public once a file is attached, the record is released and embargoDate has passed, and turns an earlier Public into Shared.

embargoDate.note: Date from which the data may be public, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty if there is no embargo. No file is attached before it.

releaseMetadata.note: Date the metadata are (or will be) public, as YYYY-MM-DD. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

license.note: SPDX licence identifier (spdx.org/licenses) of the RO, from the deposit at the identifier. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

hasMetadata.note: FAIRplus Data Maturity indicator the metadata meet (fairplus.github.io/Data-Maturity/docs/Indicators); N/A if no dataset descriptor can be assessed.

hasToxTemp.note: Whether a ToxTemp (template to report toxicity test methods) exists for the RO; N/A if the RO is not a test method or its data.

hasROCrate.note: Yes if an RO-Crate is published with the RO. On BioStudies rows the daily script sets it from the files attached to the record; edits there are overwritten.

contactPerson.note: People to contact about the RO, each written Given Family, separated by ', '.

partnerCode.note: Partner institution of the contact person.

type.note: schema.org or Bioschemas type of the RO, matching the Zenodo resource type: Dataset (dataset), ScholarlyArticle (journal article), SoftwareSourceCode (software), CreativeWork (model or poster; schema.org has no model type), ComputationalWorkflow (workflow), PresentationDigitalDocument (presentation), MediaObject (video), LearningResource (lesson). A Zenodo RO takes the type of its record.

isReviewed.note: Whether the RO and its RO-Crate metadata were reviewed within the project.

FAStatus (platform.vhp4safety.nl).note: Whether the RO can be found, discovered and/or accessed via platform.vhp4safety.nl.

notes.note: Anything no other column holds, in English; a related RO by its identifier.
